prompt: [terminal] Create a concise Taiwan working-day reference pack for the operations team. Use the provided calendar source files to produce a single `taiwan_workday_brief.txt` that explains: (1) whether the marker dates in the input are working days or holidays, (2) the next working day after each marker date, and (3) a short note about the month’s total working days. Keep it readable, but include the exact marker values from the inputs so QA can verify it quickly. Also generate a machine-readable `report.json` with the same conclusions in structured form. Do not change the input files.
